acceptanceCriteria: `id: "C12345"` returns exactly that case; unknown id returns `none-found`.
Query `"how do I cancel a paid booking"` in ranked mode returns the case above first.
Existing all-token behaviour unchanged when `match: "all"` (default or explicit, documented).
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1246 (filed 2026-10-19 against build main-fa8afe6). `corvint.docs_search_cases` (and `docs corpus search-cases`) matches a case only if every query token is a prefix of some word in the title, path, preconditions or steps. Natural-language questions ("how is a booking cancelled after payment") therefore return `none-found` because function words never all appear. The case id is not a searched field, so a known case id (e.g. `C12345`) cannot be retrieved, and there is no id parameter. Results are unranked (first N in file order).
title: docs_search_cases: id lookup and ranked any-word search (GitHub #1246)
